old-jaffa.name: Old Jaffa
old-jaffa.price_text: Free to walk · some sites charge entry
old-jaffa.hours: Streets always open · St Peter's Church and galleries have daytime hours
old-jaffa.tip: Wander the alleys early morning before the tour groups, then watch the sunset from the port.

tel-aviv-beach.name: Tel Aviv Beach
tel-aviv-beach.price_text: Free · sunbeds and umbrellas cost extra
tel-aviv-beach.hours: Open all day · lifeguards usually 07:00–17:00, longer in summer
tel-aviv-beach.tip: Gordon and Frishman beaches are central and busy; head north to Metzitzim for a quieter swim.

carmel-market.name: Carmel Market
carmel-market.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
carmel-market.hours: Sun–Thu roughly 08:00–17:00 · Fri until about 14:00 · closed Saturday
carmel-market.tip: Come Friday morning for the busiest stalls, and bring cash for small vendors.

falafel.name: Falafel
falafel.hours: Most stands Sun–Thu daytime · some close early Friday · check on the day
falafel.tip: Order it stuffed in pita with salad and tahini, and eat it standing like locals do.

luna-park.name: Luna Park, Tel Aviv
luna-park.price_text: Pay per ride or day pass · check current prices
luna-park.hours: Mostly afternoons and evenings · closed Saturday · check on the day
luna-park.tip: Good for families with kids; confirm opening hours before you go as they change by season.

superland.name: Superland
superland.price_text: Day ticket · check current prices online
superland.hours: Seasonal · usually closed Saturday · check on the day
superland.tip: It sits outside the city near Rishon LeZion, so plan a taxi or bus ride there.

neve-tzedek-walk.name: Neve Tzedek walk
neve-tzedek-walk.hours: Always open · shops and cafes daytime
neve-tzedek-walk.tip: Start at Shabazi Street and drift through the small lanes toward the sea.

sarona-market.name: Sarona Market
sarona-market.price_text: Free to enter · food priced per item
sarona-market.hours: Sun–Thu roughly 09:00–21:00 · Fri shorter · Saturday limited
sarona-market.tip: An indoor food hall, handy on a hot day or when Carmel Market is closed.

hatachana.name: HaTachana (Old Railway Station)
hatachana.hours: Shops and cafes daytime into evening · check on the day
hatachana.tip: A restored station with cafes and boutiques, a short walk from Neve Tzedek and the beach.

jaffa-port.name: Jaffa Port viewpoint
jaffa-port.tip: Come at sunset for the view back along the Tel Aviv shoreline.

tel-aviv-port.name: Tel Aviv Port (Namal)
tel-aviv-port.price_text: Free to walk · food and rentals extra
tel-aviv-port.hours: Boardwalk always open · shops and restaurants daytime into night
tel-aviv-port.tip: Walk the wooden boardwalk north and stop for a drink at one of the seafront bars.

rothschild-blvd.name: Rothschild Boulevard walk
rothschild-blvd.tip: Look for the Bauhaus buildings and the kiosks along the tree-lined centre strip.

independence-hall.name: Independence Hall (Beit Ha'atzmaut)
independence-hall.hours: Weekday tours by booking · check on the day
independence-hall.tip: Tours run by reservation, so book a slot before you travel.

tel-aviv-museum.name: Tel Aviv Museum of Art
tel-aviv-museum.price_text: Entry fee · check current price online
tel-aviv-museum.hours: Closed Sunday? check on the day · usually open most weekdays
tel-aviv-museum.tip: The modern building's atrium is worth the visit alone; allow a couple of hours.

bike-rental.name: Seafront bike ride
bike-rental.hours: Rental shops daytime · check on the day
bike-rental.tip: Ride the promenade south to Jaffa for the best coastal views.

jaffa-flea-market.name: Jaffa Flea Market
jaffa-flea-market.price_text: Free to browse · food priced per item
jaffa-flea-market.hours: Sun–Thu daytime · Friday busy · Saturday limited
jaffa-flea-market.tip: Browse the stalls, then eat at one of the small restaurants in the surrounding lanes.

gordon-beach.name: Gordon Beach
gordon-beach.tip: Central and lively, with a beach bar and easy access from the promenade.

habima-square.name: Habima Square
habima-square.tip: A good evening stop near the theatres and cafes of Rothschild.

carmel-food-tour.name: Carmel Market food tour
carmel-food-tour.tip: A guided tasting tour covers stalls you might miss alone; confirm food and drinks are included.

jaffa-old-port-tour.name: Old Jaffa walking tour
jaffa-old-port-tour.price_text: ≈ ILS 80–180 per person · check on the day
jaffa-old-port-tour.hours: Tours usually morning or late afternoon
jaffa-old-port-tour.tip: A guide brings the layered history of Jaffa to life; book a small-group tour.

beach-sunset.name: Sunset on the promenade
beach-sunset.tip: Walk south along the seafront as the sun drops for the classic Tel Aviv evening.

dizengoff-square.name: Dizengoff Square
dizengoff-square.tip: A central meeting point with cafes nearby; good for a short rest while shopping.
